import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    if not s:
        print(0)
        return
    count = 0
    p = s[0]
    even = False
    for i in range(1, len(s)):
        even = not even
        if i == len(s) - 1 and s[i] == p and even:
            count += 1
        if s[i] != p:
            p = s[i]
            count += 1 if not even else 0
            even = False
    print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
